art_direction: 内角轻转而外端断开，双瞳共同望右上，眉线松弛，无嘴。
composition: centered hand-drawn eye pair; auxiliary marks only when specified; large blank paper margins

color_randomization.method: golden-angle hue spacing with seeded single-hue saturation and lightness variation

color_treatment: one opaque flat color beside each pupil; no gradient or shaded rendering
creative_direction: Draw the upper lid from its inner end, making a small rounded turn before pulling the pen outward and lifting it early. Leave the outside corner unjoined. Both broad pupils look slightly up and right; one pupil has a straighter side. Use a single broken lower line per eye and an unfilled paper sliver within each black center. Two loose brow dashes sit at unequal heights. No mouth, eyelashes, or neatly enclosed outlines.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
